description: Immutable Phase-1 quality/cost baseline for the deep-review bug-hunter initiative (epic #1088). Downstream stories #1090-#1093 prove 'no regression' against these numbers; the Phase-4 gate #1094 consumes them as the before-reference. Do not edit without a CODEOWNER review — the pin in tests/test_deep_review_baseline.bats fails CI on any silent change.

median_escalated_review_et.reproduce: jq -s 'map(select(.tier=="deep").et)|sort as $s|($s|length) as $n|if $n%2==1 then $s[($n/2|floor)] else (($s[$n/2-1]+$s[$n/2])/2) end' tests/fixtures/et-baseline/pre-change-baseline-2026-07.jsonl
median_escalated_review_et.note: The deep tier is the escalated-review tier (triage escalates into it). Median of the 10 real deep-tier per-call ET records already committed in the et-baseline fixture and priced by scripts/token_report.sh. Epic #1088 cost cap: median ET per escalated review must stay <= 1.5x this value (514602.375).

deep_review_holdout_eval_score.note: run-eval.sh deep-review makes live model calls through the engine (run_triage). It cannot be scored in an un-credentialed context (the dev-lead sandbox reports 'Not logged in', so every case is an infra failure -> exit 2, un-scored). This aggregate score must be frozen by a credentialed CI run via an explicit CODEOWNER-reviewed PR; a proposer-identity run must never freeze its own goalpost (holdout-guard.yml, #692). Until then downstream 'no regression' checks compare a fresh credentialed run against a same-run baseline captured at gate time (#1094).

finding_verification_fp_rate.note: The false-positive signal (kind:"finding_verification" records with severity_before/after + outcome) is a DOCUMENTED SCHEMA ONLY (tests/token_report.bats, story #843) — no emit_verification_record() exists in scripts/lib/token-metrics.sh and no such records are present in the telemetry window. A real FP-rate baseline therefore cannot be captured yet; standing it up is itself a prioritized gap (see docs/initiatives/pr-review-bughunter-audit.md, mapped to #1092). Baseline = 0 finding_verification records -> FP-rate undefined. The story that first emits these records freezes this number via a CODEOWNER-reviewed PR.
